trips.route_note: Take a taxi, ride-hailing car, or local bus from Da Nang to Hoi An, which takes about 45 minutes; the ancient town is walkable from the bus stop or drop-off point.
see: Assembly Hall of the Fujian Chinese Congregation
trips.tour_query: Hoi An day trip from Da Nang
trips.why: A taxi covers the 32 km in about 30 to 45 minutes and drops you near the ancient town, while the bus takes about 1h 30m.
know: The ancient town is best explored on foot, so ask the driver to drop you at its edge.
Visiting in the evening, when the lanterns are lit, is a popular choice.

trips.route_note: Take a train from Da Nang station to Hue station, which takes about 2.5 to 3 hours, or go by car or tour over the Hai Van Pass; Hue's sights are then reached by taxi or cyclo.
trips.tour_query: Hue day trip from Da Nang
trips.why: Trains and buses take about 3 hours each way, and the Citadel and royal tombs are spread out, so a tour handles the last-mile travel best.
know: The Hai Van Pass road is scenic, so a tour or car that uses it adds appeal to the trip.
The day is long, with roughly 6 hours of travel time round trip before any sightseeing.
